grade.basis: Independently inspected composer score, including opening, mm51–64, mm99–122 and mm134–151. Viola 1 has sustained upper-register chromatic figuration and treble-clef passages; all three need clean compound-meter bowing, 12/8–9/8–6/8 changes, double stops, and close chromatic intonation. Pre-diploma overall; no extra ensemble uplift.

findings.finding: Composer-uploaded 33-page complete score and three numbered independent viola parts downloaded through observed ImagefromIndex 65997 / IMSLPImageHandler/65997. Title page and score copyright give 1996. Composer notes final version 2014-12-22 and a 2019 correction to viola 2 m146.

grade.basis: Independently inspected complete eight-page typeset score, notably mm39–55 and 106–118. First cello carries exposed upper-register figuration and Presto runs; cello 2 shares rapid treble-clef material and lower parts also require high-register/clef changes, chords and coordinated fast articulation. Diploma overall.

findings.finding: Observed ImagefromIndex 265982 gave complete typeset score; PDF has six individually labelled cello staves and complete ending. Separate parts 265983–265988 are listed; manuscript score also listed. One continuous work, not five movements. No reliable date or duration.

Institutional 2023 event program names Fantasia orientale and Rossini Cellos Orchestra, listing sixteen cellists and conductor Claudio Casadei. It does not identify original six-part scoring or a different arrangement and is a program announcement, not confirmation of completed exact-version performance. Doubling itself is not a disqualification.
